notes.title: Release 206 - Polishing autocast
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an option to deactivate the new autocast feature completely.
[*] Added an option to change the time it takes to activate autocast.
[*] A selected spell will no longer be deselected if another spell is cast by the new autocast feature.
[*] The correct tooltip is now displayed after deactivating autocast.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 204
notes.content:
[h3]Added the autocast option for the following abilities: Bombshower, Stun Bomb, Arcane Bolt, Fireball, Frost Bolt.[/h3]
[list]
[*] To activate it the button of the ability has to be pressed for 1 second. The button will glow while autocast is active.
[*] If the Guardian is out of resources the autocast will be repeated after a 5 seconds delay.
[*] I might add the autocast option for more features in the future if you guys want it.
[/list]
[h3]Added the option to upgrade a region's soul crystal based on the highest soul crystal level.[/h3]
[list]
[*] For example, if your snowy region is at soul crystal level 10, all other regions can be upgraded to 9.
[/list]
[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the class restriction for mana potions.
[*] Renamed the existing Autocast to Smartcast in the options menu.
[*] Having smartcast activated won't interfere with the new autocast.
[*] Fixed a crash related to input fields.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix '1.0.203.1'
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Pressing the shortcut for a spell while the tower menu is open no longer blocks the first click on the map.
[*] Fixed a bug regarding unlocking Rakui Castle stages on higher soul crystal levels.
[*] The accuracy description now supports values up to monster level 500.
[*] Increased the processing speed of the alchemist by 11%.
[*] Improved smoothness of guardian movement with high movement speed.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 202 - Balance changes and Russian localization
notes.content:
[h2]General Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Russian localization.
[*] The refill ammunition button is now only displayed if the "Stun Bomb" skill is learned.
[*] Changed image and the font size of the bag filter buttons.
[*] The Guardian no longer moves when a tower selection is closed by tapping or left-clicking.
[/list]
[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]
	[h3]General:[/h3]
[list]
		[*] Towers now benefit by increases to the Guardian's critical multiplier. 50% of the Guardian's critical multiplier is now counted towards towers.
		[*] Attack Command now hast 10% more range.
[/list]
	[h3]Builder: [/h3]
[list]
		[*] Efficiency now reduces tower cost by 2.5% (up from 2%).
		[*] Clockwork now increases tower accuracy by 10%.
		[*] Clockwork now adds the Builder's crit chance to the tower's crit chance.
[/list]
	[h3]Fighter: [/h3]
[list]
		[*] Battle Shout and Shout of Carnage now last 15 seconds (up from 8) and have 10% more range.
		[*] Heavy Strikes now increases Strength by 4% per talent level (previously 5% attack damage).
[/list]
	[h3]Magician:[/h3]
[list]
		[*] Increased the area of effect of the teleport explosion by 150% and reduced the base cooldown to 30 seconds (The arcane tree still needs a rework but I have no time).
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
	[*] Fixed a crash for specific mobile devices.
	[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to start levels at soul crystal level 34 and up.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix '1.0.200.1' (29-September-2021)
notes.content:
The price to upgrade godly items is now calculated properly.
Godly T7 items can now be disenchanted to get the respective orb.
Bag tab changes:
[list]
[*] Added a "Move All" button to the bag popup that will allow you to move all displayed items to a different tab.
[*] Selecting items for fusion will no longer move the remaining items to the default bag.
[*] Clearing the fusion input inventory now tries to add the items to a bag tab where the same item exists already.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 199
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Players with multiple tabs have the move to button for items in the trade popup again.
[*] Increased the size of UI elements in the bag settings menu.
[*] Stackable items are now automatically filtered into tabs in which the same stackable item already exists (as long as there is enough space).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 197 (22-September-2021) - Voidlord Orbs
notes.content:
General:
[list]
[*] Increased the size of the wiki level input field and set the max level to 300.
[*] Voidlord items can now be upgraded to rank 10 by using the new Voidlord orbs. I will announce it as soon as the orbs can be obtained by disenchanting.
[*] Added the possibility to purchase additional bag tabs.
[*] Talent changes will no longer be synchronized with the server until the talent popup is closed.
[*] Chain production now produces more items before stopping.
[*] Added a filter for godly items.
[/list]
In between patches:
[list]
[*] The world Map treasure demon drops 20% more items now and has a higher chance to drop blueprints and accessories.
[/list]
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the Steam registration.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 195 (19-August-2021) - Release of T7 items
notes.content:
General:
[list]
[*] 	Added bag filters for builder, fighter, and magician.
[*] 	Added a shortcut to call the next wave. The default button is z. As usual, the shortcut can be changed in the pause menu.
[*] 	Added a few tooltips and their translations.
[*] 	Localized some additional strings.
[*] 	Adjusted the Accuracy tooltip to change when the hero has a very high accuracy value.
[/list]
Tier 7 items 
[list]
[*] 	Will be unlocked as soon as the client updates are available on all platforms.
[*] 	T7 items start dropping with monster level 130.
[*] 	T7 items won't be tradable.
[*] 	They have a different cosmetic base design from the other item sets and won't be included in the 'Freedom of Choice Bundle'.
[*] 	Buildings can now be upgraded to level 7.
[/list]
Balance changes:
[list]
[*] 	The chance to hit an enemy can never fall below 5% now.
[*] 	Monster above level 130 now gain an additional damage reduction (this effect won't be activated until T7 items are enabled).
[*] In between patches:
[*] 	Increased the armour break rolls for items starting from tier 3.
[*] 	Rings and Amulets now have a chance to roll weapon damage.
[*] 	Bronze items can now drop starting with monster level 8 instead of 10.
[*] 	Iron items can now drop starting with monster level 18 instead of 20.
[/list]
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] 	There should be less cases of server/client state discrepancies.
[*] 	Fixed some trade-related issues.
[*] 	Fixed the name generation for net extension blueprints.
[/list]

notes.title: Version '1.0.194.1'
notes.content:
General:
[list]
[*] Increased the stack size of consumables from 10 to 100.
[*] Increased the stack size of materials to 100.
[*] Increased the stack size of blueprints from 5 to 50.
[*] To stack up everything properly you might have to press arrange several times (I didn't have the time to adjust the arrange function).
[*] Added a description to the market.
[*] Leveling/ranking up buildings reduces the item processing time 20% more than before.
[/list]
Changes applied in between patches:
[list]
[*] The world map treasure demon can no longer spawn on small checkpoints.
[*] The rarity of loot slowly increases now depending on the enemy level. This effect is multiplicative with the item rarity stat.
[*] Gloves can now roll the Accuracy stat.
[*] Light and Heavy Armour: Gloves, Pants, Boots and Body Armour can now roll Intelligence.
[*] Monsters above level 50 no longer drop grey items. If they would drop a grey item it is instead converted to diamonds for double the value.
[/list]
Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed 2 crashes.
[*] Fixed some localization errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 192 (23-July-2021) - Now also in Spanish!
notes.content:
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] 'Arrange' now sorts the items in your bag by their value. Stacked items are sorted as if there is only one item on the stack.
[*] Added a shine effect to the tower purchase confirmation button.
[*] Added the possibility to see multiple resource bars if necessary (e.g. if the rage chalice is used).
[*] Ranged attacks can now generate rage on kill.
[*] Improved the request handling between server and client.
[*] Canceling an outgoing trade request now properly removes the trade request popup of the other party.
[*] Added a glow to the soul crystals on the world map and made it easier to press them.
[*] The crafting selection menu overlays are now hidden while an item is being crafted. The progress bar should now no longer be overlapped.
[*] Added more tooltips.
[*] It is no longer necessary to click a tower twice to build it.
[*] 'Escape' is now the default button to close popups and building menus.
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgrading runes no longer increases the mana multiplier.
[/list]
[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a localization functionality for item names.
[*] Set bonuses and void items are now localized.
[*] Towers and skills are now localized.
[*] The building menu is now fully localized.
[*] Added Spanish localization.
[*] Fixed some localization bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 190 - German Localization and Tooltips
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
	- Added the NPC Disenchanter Ifahrim. He will enable the instant disenchant feature after unlocking him.
	- The in-game-chat is now also deactivated as soon as the user right clicks somewhere on the map.
	- Added a shortcut to show/hide the in-game-chat. The default button is c.
	- Implemented tooltips and added explanations to stats in the item popups.
[b]UI changes:[/b]
	- Pressing 'enter' in the login scene tries to log you in now (while not typing in a textfield).
	- Pressing enter (or submit on mobile devices) in the textfields of the login/register scene now activates the next textfield executes the login/register if it's the last textline.
	- Removed the notifications On/Off button in the settings. Notfications are not used and it's not planned to use them in the near future.
[b]Localization:[/b]
	- Added a language button to the login screen (The language button in the settings still exists).
	- The language switch works now immediately without restarting the app.
	- Added ~450 german string translations. With this ~95% of the game is translated to german.
	- Renamed recipe to blueprint.
[b]Adjustments:[/b]
	- Reduced needed bandwidth for initial level creation (might be of interest for mobile users).
	- Changed the layout of levels 3-5 of the spider caves.
	- Textfields now use less resources for big inputs.
	- Sending a text message no longer displays the "Waiting for server" message box.
	- The unique IDs of items are no longer displayed in the item popup.
	- The learn blueprint popup now also shows blueprints for which the building level is too low (before it only showed blueprints if the rank was too low).
[b]Balance changes:[/b]
	- Increased the maximum stun resilience to 90% (up from 80%)
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
	- Textfields are now properly updated after linking items
	- The tutorial to upgrade the building rank is no longer displayed in the guardian menu.

notes.title: Version '1.0.189.1' (26-February-2021)
notes.content:
[b]General changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] - Added a shortcut for refilling ammunition (e.g. Stun Bombs).
[*] - Added the in-game chat.
[*] - Pressing the enter button now sets the chat inputfield active.
[*] - Added a SFX for refilling ammunition.
[*] - Added the first version of the Bestiary showing monster stats. The monster level can be adjusted and the stats will change accordingly. Monster descriptions and special attacks might follow in future.
[*] - Added 2 upgrades for defensive support towers.
[*] - The tier 2 archer tower is now unlocked after completing the tutorial level.
[/list]

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] - The freeze effect of the "Strong Frostbite Set" now also stuns the target for 3 seconds.
[*] - Lowered the attack speed of all Golem type monsters.
[*] - Ancient Hammer's double damage effect is now active for 3 seconds instead of 1 attack.
[*] - Increased the attack damage of the Spider Boss.
[*] - Lowered the base damage of Orc Assassins, but increased the attack speed and crit chance.
[*] - Lowered the attack speed and armour penetration of the Hammer Orc.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	- It's now possible to have the effect of Battleshout and Shout of Carnage at the same time on towers.
[*] 	- Fixed a crash related to the Guardian death.
[/list]
[b]Technical changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] 	- It's now possible to choose Guardian names with unicode.
[*] 	- Changed the code of the settings menu - Please tell me if you find some new bugs here!
[*] 	- Implemented a new textfield widget, which should solve the issue with disappearing textfields. That being said - the bug report field is still a native widget and won't be changed soon. If you have trouble using the ingame report field, please write it in the general chat ingame or even better write it in the appropriate Discord channel. Thanks for your continued support!
[/list]
